title: $k$-Pairing: A Generalization of the Partition Pairing Theorems
summary: We extend the partition pairing theory of Andrews and Dastidar by replacing pairs with groups of $k$ equal parts. Two weight-preserving bijections give combinatorial interpretations of the joint pairing index--width distribution and the negative-rank enumerations. The first combines conjugation with the Stockhofe--Keith correspondence and sends the $k$-pairing index and width to the number of parts and the largest part, respectively.
